u(perba/llw.head: †ὑπερβάλλω
u(perba/llw.html: †ὑπερβάλλω ὑπειρβάλλω [ὑπερ- 3.] Aor. ὑπειρέβαλον Il. 23.637. 3 sing. ὑπέρβαλε Il. 23.843, 847. Infin. ὑπερβαλέειν Od. 11.597. 1 To topple or push over. With acc. , [λᾶαν] ἄκρον ὑπερβαλέειν Od. 11.597. 2 To throw or cast a missile, make a throw or cast, further than (another), outthrow (him). With genit. : τόσσον παντὸς ἀγῶνος ὑπέρβαλεν Il. 23.847. With acc. : δουρὶ ὑπειρέβαλον φυλῆα Il. 23.637. To make a throw or cast further than or beyond (a specified distance). With acc. : ὑπέρβαλε σήματα πάντων Il. 23.843.

u(perah/s.head: ὑπεραής
u(perah/s.html: ὑπεραής [ὑπερ- 1 + ἄημι.] (Cf. ἀκραής.) Of wind, blowing on high Il. 11.297.

u(poblh/dhn.head: ὑποβλήδην
u(poblh/dhn.html: ὑποβλήδην [ὑποβάλλω 2.] Throwing in a word, interrupting: ὑ. ἠμείβετο Il. 1.292.

u(bristh/s.head: ὑβριστής
u(bristh/s.html: ὑβριστής [ὑβρίζω.] Having no regard for right or decency, wanton, violent Il. 13.633 : Od. 6.120 = Od. 9.175 = Od. 13.201, Od. 24.282.

u(phnh/ths.head: ὑπηνήτης
u(phnh/ths.html: ὑπηνήτης [ὑπήνη, hair on the lower part of the face, fr. ὑπ-, ὑπο- 4 + ἠν-, face. Cf. ἀπηνής, πρηνής.] Having hair sprouting on the lower part of the face, getting a beard: πρῶτον ὑπηνήτῃ Il. 24.348: Od. 10.279.

u(po/dra.head: ὑπόδρα
u(po/dra.html: ὑπόδρα [ὑπο- 2 + an uncertain second element.] (Looking) from beneath, (the eye-brows), with a scowl: ὑπόδρα ἰδών Il. 1.148=Il. 22.260 = 344=Il. 24.559, Il. 2.245, Il. 4.349=Il. 14.82, Il. 4.411=Il. 5.251=Il. 10.446, Il. 5.888, Il. 12.230=Il. 17.169=Il. 18.284, Il. 15.13, Il. 17.141, Il. 20.428: Od. 8.165=Od. 18.14=Od. 22.60 = 320, Od. 17.459=Od. 18.388, Od. 18.337=Od. 19.70, Od. 22.34.

u(perdeh/s.head: ὑπερδεής
u(perdeh/s.html: ὑπερδεής (ὑπερδεϝής) [ὑπερ- 5 + δε(ϝ)-, δεύω2.] Acc. sing. ὑπερδέα (for ὑπερδεέα). Very scanty, very small in number : ὑπερδέα δῆμον ἔχοντας Il. 17.330.

u(perei/pw.head: †ὑπερείπω
u(perei/pw.html: †ὑπερείπω [ὑπ-, ὑπο- 4.] 3 sing. aor. ὑπήριπε. To give way beneath one, collapse : ὑπήριπε γυῖα Il. 23.691.

u(peri/wn.head: Ὑπερίων
u(peri/wn.html: Ὑπερίων -ονος [ὑπέρ. App. a patronymic in form. Cf. οὐρανίωνες.] He that is on high, that bestrides the heavens. A name of the sun Od. 1.24. Joined with Ἠέλιος Il. 8.480 : Od. 1.8, Od. 12.133, 263, 346, 374. With ἠλέκτωρ Il. 19.398.

u(pa/lucis.head: ὑπάλυξις
u(pa/lucis.html: ὑπάλυξις ἡ [ὑπαλύσκω.] A possibility or the means of escape : κακῶν ὑπάλυξιν (from . . .) Od. 23.287. Cf. Il. 22.270.

u(you=.head: ὑψοῦ
u(you=.html: ὑψοῦ [cf. ὕψι.] 1 On high, high up, aloft : ὑψοῦ κάρη ἔχει Il. 6.509= Il. 15.266. Cf. Il. 13.12, 200, 201. 2 To a high or relatively high position, high : νῆα ἔρυσσαν ὑψοῦ ἐπὶ ψαμάθοις (high and dry) Il. 1.486. So that something may have a considerable height : ἴκρια πῆξαι ὑψοῦ (make it of a good height) Od. 5.164. 3 Afloat (cf. ὕψι 3) : ὑψοῦ νῆʼ ὅρμισαν Od. 4.785, Od. 8.55.

u(potarta/rios.head: ὑποταρτάριος
u(potarta/rios.html: ὑποταρτάριος [ὑπο- 4 + Τάρταρος.] That is below in Tartarus : θεούς Il. 14.279.

u(po/tropos.head: ὑπότροπος
u(po/tropos.html: ὑπότροπος [ὑπο- 10 + τρέπω.] Returning, coming back : ὑπότροπον ἐκ πολέμοιο Il. 6.501. Cf. Il. 6.367 : Od. 20.332, Od. 21.211, Od. 22.35.

u(perw/|h.head: ὑπερῴη
u(perw/|h.html: ὑπερῴη -ης, ἡ [ὑπέρ.] The upper part of the mouth, the palate Il. 22.495.

u(palu/skw.head: †ὑπαλύσκω
u(palu/skw.html: †ὑπαλύσκω [ὑπ-, ὑπο- 3.] 2 sing. aor. ὑπάλυξας Il. 11.451. 3 sing. ὑπάλυξε Od. 4.512, Od. 5.430, Od. 19.189. Pple. ὑπαλύξας Od. 8.355. Infin. ὑπαλύξαι Il. 12.327. 1 To keep away from, escape from, avoid, shun (impending danger) : κῆρας Od. 4.512. Cf. Il. 12.327. 2 To get away, effect one's escape or release, from (danger or an obligation in which one is involved) : κῦμα Od. 5.430, χρεῖος Od. 8.355. Cf. Od. 19.189. 3 Absol., to effect one's escape, escape, save oneself : φθῆ σε τέλος θανάτοιο κιχήμενον, οὐδʼ ὑπάλυξας Il. 11.451.

u(potre/xw.head: †ὑποτρέχω
u(potre/xw.html: †ὑποτρέχω [ὑπο- 8.] 3 sing. aor. ὑπέδραμε. To run in under the weapon of a foe : ὑπέδραμε καὶ λάβε γούνων Il. 21.68 : Od. 10.323.

u(paspi/dios.head: ὑπασπίδιος
u(paspi/dios.html: ὑπασπίδιος [ὑπ-, ὑπο- 4 + ἀσπίδ-, ἀσπίς.] In neut. pl. ὑπασπίδια as adv., under the shielf, under guard of the shield : ὑ. προποδίζων Il. 13.158. Cf. Il. 13.807, Il. 16.609.

u(sta/tios.head: ὑστάτιος
u(sta/tios.html: ὑστάτιος -η, -ον [ὕστατος.] 1 = ὕστατος 1 Il. 15.634. 2 = ὕστατος 2.b Od. 9.14. 3 In neut. sing. ὑστάτιον as adv. = ὕστατος 3.a : οὐκέτι Δαναῶν κεκαδησόμεθʼ ὑστάτιόν περ (i.e. it is our last chance) Il. 8.353.

u(po/.head: ὑπό
u(po/.html: ὑπό Also ὑπαί Il. 2.824, Il. 3.217, Il. 10.376, Il. 11.417, etc. (ὑπό commonly with anastrophe when immediately following the vb. or case-form.) I Adv. 1 From under or beneath something : ὑπαὶ δὲ ἴδεσκεν (looked up from under his brow) Il. 3.217 (cf. ὑπόδρα), ἔλυεν ὑφʼ ἷππους Il. 23.513. Cf. Il. 18.319. 2 From the power, range or reach of something: ἦλθε φυγὼν ὕπο νηλεὲς ἦμαρ Il. 21.57. Cf. Il. 12.113, Il. 13.395: Od. 9.17, Od. 23.332. 3 Under or beneath something, underneath, below: ὑφʼ ἕρματα τάνυσσαν Il. 1.486, ὑπὸ τρόμος ἔλλαβε γυῖα Il. 3.34, Il. 14.506, ὑπὸ γλῶσσαν τάμεν (at the root) Il. 5.74. Cf. Il. 7.6, Il. 10.155, Il. 11.579, 635, Il. 14.240, etc.: Od. 1.130, Od. 4.636 (at the teat), Od. 8.436, Od. 11.527, Od. 16.47, Od. 23.204, etc. 4 Indicating coming under an obligation or undertaking. See ἔχω (IV) (4). 5 Indicating occasion, cause, accompaniment, thereat, therewith, thereto: ὑπό κεν ταλασίφρονά περ δέος εἷλεν Il. 4.421, χώρησαν δʼ ὑπὸ πρόμαχοι Il. 4.505, ὑπὸ δʼ ἔστρεφον ἡνιοχῆες (following the movement of the lines) Il. 5.505. Cf. Il. 4.497, Il. 8.4, Il. 11.417, Il. 18.570 (to the lyre), Il. 23.108, etc.: Od. 4.113, Od. 8.380, Od. 16.215, Od. 21.411, etc. II Prep. 1 With genit. a From under or beneath: ὑπὸ δʼ ἥρεον ἕρματα νηῶν Il. 2.154. Cf. Il. 8.543, Il. 13.611, Il. 19.17, etc.: κρήνη [ῥέει] ὑπὸ σπείους Od. 9.141. Cf. Od. 4.39, Od. 7.5, Od. 9.463, Od. 22.364, etc. So with ablative: ζυγόφιν Il. 19.404, Il. 24.576, ὄχεσφιν Il. 23.7. b In reference to saving or escaping, away from, from, from out of: ἐρύεσθαι ὑπὸ Τρώων ὀρυμαγδοῦ Il. 9.248. Cf. Il. 8.363, Il. 12.74, Il. 17.224, 645, Il. 19.73: ἀνσχεθέειν ὑπὸ κύματος ὁρμῆς Od. 5.320. Sim. in reference to carrying off from a protector: νεκρὸν ὑπʼ Αἴαντος ἐρύειν Il. 17.235. Cf. Il. 13.198. c In reference to position, under, beneath, underneath: ἱμάς, ὅς οἱ ὑπʼ ἀνθερεῶνος τέτατο Il. 3.372. Cf. Il. 5.796, Il. 8.14, Il. 21.318, Il. 23.874: οὔ πω ἐτέθαπτο ὑπὸ χθονὸς εὐρυοδείης Od. 11.52. Sim. in reference to taking hold or grasping: ὑπʼ ἀνθερεῶνος ἑλοῦσα Il. 1.501. Cf. Il. 11.842. d Passing into the next sense: ὑπὸ δὲ στεναχίζετο γαῖα λαῶν ἱζόντων Il. 2.95, σμῶδιξ ἐξυπανέστη σκήπτρου ὕπο 268. Cf. Il. 13.27, Il. 14.285, etc.: Od. 9.484, Od. 12.406, Od. 16.10, etc. e Under the influence of, under compulsion or stress of, by the power, force, agency or means of, caused by, under, because of, by reason of, by, from, before, at: εὖτʼ ἂν ὑφʼ Ἕκτορος πίπτωσιν Il. 1.242, μὴ ὑπʼ αὐτοῦ δουρὶ δαμήῃς Il. 3.436, ὑπὸ ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς Il. 4.276. Cf. Il. 2.334, Il. 3.61, 128, Il. 5.92, Il. 6.73, Il. 7.64, Il. 8.149, 183, Il. 10.376, Il. 11.119, 391, Il. 12.462, Il. 13.140, Il. 14.414, Il. 15.171, 275 (at the sound of it), Il. 16.519, Il. 21.12, Il. 23.86, etc.: ὑπʼ ἀνάγκης Od. 2.110, ὑπὸ κύματος ἀρθείς Od. 5.393. Cf. Od. 7.263, Od. 8.192, Od. 9.66, Od. 10.78, Od. 19.114, etc. f In reference to accompaniment: δαΐδων ὕπο (to the light of . . .) Il. 18.492: Od. 19.48, Od. 23.290. g In reference to motion to a point under something: ὡς ὅτε κῦμʼ ἐν νηῒ πέσῃσι λάβρον ὑπαὶ νεφέων (seeming to reach them) Il. 15.625. Cf. Il. 16.375: τὸν μοχλὸν ὑπὸ σποδοῦ ἤλασα Od. 9.375. Cf. Od. 5.346, 373. With verbs of striking, etc.: ὑπὸ στέρνοιο τυχήσας Il. 4.106. Cf. Il. 13.177, 671, Il. 14.493, Il. 23.875, etc.– h In reference to passing under something: βάλʼ αὐχένʼ ὑπὸ στεφάνης Il. 7.12. Cf. Il. 11.259, 424, 579=Il. 13.412=Il. 17.349, Il. 16.339, 347, Il. 21.591: Od. 18.96. 2 With dat. a In reference to position, under, beneath, underneath: ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ Il. 2.307, ἐπεὶ ζεύξειεν ὑφʼ ἅρμασιν ἵππους Il. 24.14. Cf. Il. 4.44, Il. 6.396, Il. 9.472, Il. 10.152, Il. 13.88, Il. 16.378, Il. 18.244, etc. : Od. 1.186, Od. 3.478, Od. 4.153, Od. 8.522, Od. 9.443, Od. 10.359, Od. 14.533, Od. 15.469, etc. So with locative: ὄχεσφιν Il. 8.41, κράτεσφιν Il. 10.156, etc. Sim.: βορέω ὑπʼ ἰωγῇ Od. 14.533. In pregnant sense: ποσσὶ δʼ ὑπʼ ἐδήσατο πέδιλα Il. 2.44. Cf. Il. 5.693, Il. 8.267, Il. 18.375, Il. 24.644, etc.: Od. 1.96, Od. 4.297, Od. 9.245, Od. 22.449, etc. b Passing into the next sense: ὑπὸ ποσσὶ στεναχίζετο γαῖα Il. 2.784. Cf. Il. 3.13, Il. 11.151, Il. 13.19, Il. 19.363, Il. 20.497, etc.: εἴκοι ὑπὸ βῶλος ἀρότρῳ Od. 18.374. c =1.e : χερσὶν ὑφʼ ἡμετέρῃσιν ἁλοῦσα Il. 2.374 θεῶν ὑπὸ πομπῇ (under their conduct) Il. 6.171, ὕπνῳ ὕπο Il. 24.636. Cf. Il. 3.352, Il. 5.93, Il. 6.453, Il. 7.129, Il. 11.433, Il. 13.590, etc.: ὤλεθʼ ὑπʼ Αἰγίσθοιο δόλῳ Od. 3.235, γήρᾳ ὕπο λιπαρῷ ἀρημένον Od. 11.136. Cf. Od. 4.295, 402, 790, Od. 7.193, Od. 13.82, Od. 18.156, Od. 19.488, etc. So with locative: ἐπόρνυέ οἱ μόρσιμον ἦμαρ ὑπὸ Πηλεΐδαο βίηφιν Il. 15.614. d In subjection to, under the charge or guidance of, under: ὑφʼ ἡνιόχῳ εἰωθότι Il. 5.231. Cf. Il. 6.159, Il. 9.156, 298: δέδμητο λαός ὑπʼ αὐτῷ Od. 3.305. Cf. Od. 7.68. e Indicating the subjection of the female to the male in conception and in reference to the bearing of offspring, by: ἥ μιν ὑπʼ Ἀγχίσῃ τέκεν Il. 5.313. Cf. Il. 2.714, Il. 7.469, Il. 14.492, etc.: ἥ ῤʼ ὑπὸ τυνδαρέῳ γείνατο παῖδε Od. 11.299. Sim.: Ἀφροδίτης, τὴν ἄρʼ ὑπὸ μνηστῆρσιν ἔχον Od. 22.445. 3 With acc. a In reference to motion to a point under something: ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθεν (to the walls of . . .) Il. 2.216, ὑπὸ σπέος ἤλασε μῆλα Il. 4.279. Cf. Il. 4.407, Il. 5.731, Il. 8.271, Il. 11.181, Il. 12.264, Od. 18.145, Il. 22.195, Il. 23.51, etc.: Od. 3.335, Od. 4.146, 425, 445, Od. 5.481, Od. 9.99, Od. 10.191, Od. 14.469, Od. 20.81, Od. 24.234, etc. With verbs of striking, etc.: βάλε λαιμὸν ὑπʼ ἀνθερεῶνα Il. 13.388. Cf. Il. 13.615, Il. 17.309, Il. 20.275. b In reference to motion passing under something: τρέσε τεῖχος ὕπο Τρώων Il. 22.144. Cf. Il. 5.67, Il. 13.652, Il. 18.281: κρήνη ὑπʼ αὐλῆς οὐδὸν ἵησιν Od. 7.130. Cf. Od. 2.181. c In reference to position, stretching, extending, lying or being under, under, beneath, underneath: οἳ δʼ ἔχον Ἀρκαδίην ὑπὸ Κυλλήνης ὄρος Il. 2.603. Cf. Il. 2.824, Il. 3.371, Il. 5.267, Il. 19.259, Il. 22.307: μάλα πῖαρ ὑπʼ οὖδάς [ἐστιν] Od. 9.135. Cf. Od. 9.433, Od. 11.498, 619, Od. 15.349, Od. 22.362. d In reference to time, during, throughout the time of: πάνθʼ ὑπὸ μηνιθμόν Il. 16.202. In the course of: νύχθʼ ὑπὸ τήνδε Il. 22.102.

u(pe/rteros.head: ὑπέρτερος
u(pe/rteros.html: ὑπέρτερος [comp. fr. ὑπέρ.] 1 Relating to the upper hand or victory : εὖχος (the glory of victory) Il. 11.290. So κῦδος Il. 12.437, Il. 15.491, 644. 2 Of higher rank, one's superior : γενεῇ ὑ. Il. 11.786. 3 In reference to position in relation to a centre, on the outside, the outside . . .: κρέα (the fleshy muscular parts as opposed to the entrails) Od. 3.65=470 = Od. 20.279.

u(pofqa/nw.head: †ὑποφθάνω
u(pofqa/nw.html: †ὑποφθάνω [ὑπο- 12.] Aor. pple. ὑποφθάς Il. 7.144. Aor. pple. mid. ὑποφθάμενος Od. 4.547. Fem. ὑποφθαμένη Od. 15.171. In act. and mid., to anticipate : τὸν ὑποφθαμένη φάτο μῦθον (getting in her word first) Od. 15.171. Absol., to be beforehand in doing something : ὑποφθὰς δουρὶ περόνησεν (getting in his blow first) Il. 7.144. Cf. Od. 4.547.

u(po/yios.head: ὑπόψιος
u(po/yios.html: ὑπόψιος [ὑπ-, ὑπο- 2 + ὀπ-. See ὁράω. Looked at from below. Cf. πανόψιος.] An object of contempt or hatred : ὑπόψιον ἄλλων (to . . .) Il. 3.42.

u(pemnh/muke.head: ὑπεμνήμυκε
u(pemnh/muke.html: ὑπεμνήμυκε ὑπομνήμυκε App. for ὑπεμήμυκε, 3 sing. pf. ὑπημύω, fr. ὑπ-, ὑπο- 4 + ἠμύω. Thus, to be bowed down, hang one's head : πάντʼ ὐ. (finds humiliation everywhere) Il. 22.491.

u(poxe/w.head: †ὑποχέω
u(poxe/w.html: †ὑποχέω [ὑπο- 4.] 3 sing. aor. ὑπέχευε. To spread or strew under a person : βοείας Il. 11.843 : ῥῶπας Od. 14.49.

u(pe/nerqe.head: ὑπένερθε
u(pe/nerqe.html: ὑπένερθε [ὑπ-, ὑπο- 4 + ἔνερθε.] 1 Beneath, below : οἳ ὑ. καμόντας ἀνθρώπους τίνυσθον (in the underworld) Il. 3.278. Cf. Il. 4.147, Il. 13.30, Il. 17.386, Il. 20.61 : ὑπένερθε λῖθʼ ὑπέβαλλεν Od. 10.353. Cf.Od. 12.242. 2 With reference to position in relation to something surrounding, below, underneath, within: εἰρύσατο ζωστὴρ ἠδʼ ὑ. ζῶμα Il. 4.186. Cf. Il. 4.215. 3 With genit. a Beneath, below, under : ποδῶν ὑ. Il. 2.150. b In a geographical context, under shelter of, under the lee of : ὑ. Χίοιο Od. 3.172.

u(yipe/thlos.head: ὑψιπέτηλος
u(yipe/thlos.html: ὑψιπέτηλος [ὕψι + πέταλον.] Lofty and leafy (cf. ὑψίκομος): δένδρεον Il. 13.437 : Od. 4.458. Cf. Od. 11.588.

u(po/sxesis.head: ὑπόσχεσις
u(po/sxesis.html: ὑπόσχεσις ἡ [ὑποσχ-, ὑπίσχομαι.] A promise, undertaking, engagement Il. 2.286, 349 : Od. 10.483.

u(pe/reia.head: Ὑπέρεια-1.
u(pe/reia.html:
Ὑπέρεια-1. A fountain believed to have been in the town of Pherae . The people living about it led by Eurypylus-2 Il. 2.734; Il. 6.457.
Ὑπέρεια-2 (εὐρύχορος). The old home of the Phaeacians, near the Cyclopes Od. 6.4.

u(lakte/w.head: ὑλακτέω
u(lakte/w.html: ὑλακτέω [ὑλάω.] Of dogs, to bark or bay Il. 18.586. Fig. of the oppressed heart seeking relief : κραδίη οἱ ἔνδον ὑλάκτει Od. 20.13. Cf. Od. 20.16.

u(/paiqa.head: ὕπαιθα
u(/paiqa.html: ὕπαιθα [ὑπαί.] 1 Away from under; hence, out of reach, eluding a foe : ὑ. λιάσθη Il. 15.520. Cf. Il. 21.493, Il. 22.141. 2 Under :ὑ. ῥέων (i.e. carrying him off his legs) Il. 21.271. 3 With genit. a Away from under, out of reach of, eluding : ὕπαιθα τοῖο λιασθείς Il. 21.255. b Under : ἄνακτος (i.e. supporting him) Il. 18.421.

u(/steros.head: ὕστερος
u(/steros.html: ὕστερος [comp. Cf. ὕστατος.] 1 After another, later, second, afterwards : ὑ. ὄρνυτο χαλκῷ Il. 5.17= Il. 16.479, ὕστερος ἐλθών Il. 18.320. Cf. Od. 24.155. With genit., later than, after : σεῦ ὕστερος Il. 18.333. 2 In neut. sing. ὕστερον as adv. a After another, later, afterwards : ἐμὲ προτὶ ἄστυ ὑ. ἄξει Od. 16.272. b Later, afterwards, in the future, another time or day : ὑ. αὖτις ἰόντα Il. 1.27. Cf. Il. 7.30, 291, 377 = 396, Il. 8.142, Il. 10.450, Il. 11.365 = Il. 20.452, Il. 14.313, Il. 20.127 : ὑ. ἄλλον ἥσειν Od. 8.202. Cf. Od. 9.351. Sim. ἐς ὕστερον : ἐς ὑ. ὁρμηθῆναι (a second time, again) Od. 12.126. 3 In neut. pl. ὕστερα as adv. in the sense 2.b: ὑ. ταῦτα πένεσθαι Od. 16.319. 4 Born later, younger : γένει ὕστερος Il. 3.215.

u(polu/w.head: ὑπολύω
u(polu/w.html: ὑπολύω [ὑπο- 3, ὑπο- 4.] 3 pl. aor. pass. ὑπέλυντο Il. 16.341. 1 To set free or release from something: ὑπέλυσα ἑταίρους Od. 9.463. To set free or release from. With genit. In mid.: τὸν ὑπελύσαο δεσμῶν Il. 1.401. 2 To break up or dissipate (the vital forces), cause (the limbs) to give way or collapse under one, by the application of force to fatal effect (the prefix app. referring in strictness only to the limbs): τῶν ὑπέλυσε μένος καὶ γυῖα Il. 6.27. Cf. Il. 16.341, Il. 23.726. In reference to an animal Il. 15.581.

u(pe/r.head: ὑπέρ
u(pe/r.html: ὑπέρ [in form comp. fr. ὑπό.] Also (in phrase ὑπεὶρ ἅλα) ὑπείρ Il. 23.227, Il. 24.13 : Od. 3.73, Od. 4.172, Od. 9.254. (ὑπέρ commonly with anastrophe when immediately following the case-form.) Prep. with 1 Acc. a In reference to motion or extent over a space : τὸ δὲ τεῖχος ὕπερ πᾶν δοῦπος ὀρώρει Il. 12.289. Cf. Il. 23.227, Il. 24.13 : ἦ μαψιδίως ἀλάλησθε ὑπεὶρ ἅλα; Od. 3.73 = Od. 9.254. Cf. Od. 4.172, Od. 9.260. b In reference to passing over an object : ὑπὲρ ὦμον ἤλυθʼ ἀκωκή Il. 5.16, δόρυ χροὸς ἀντετόρησε πρυμνὸν ὕπερ θέναρος 339 (app. the κόλπος of the robe is held up in defence by the hand with the palm outwards). Cf. Il. 5.851, Il. 10.373, etc. : Od. 7.135, Od. 22.279, etc. c In excess of, beyond, in violation, transgression or defiance of : αἶσαν Il. 3.59 = Il. 6.333, Il. 6.487, Il. 16.780, ὅρκια Il. 3.299, Il. 4.67 = 72, 236, 271, Διὸς αἶσαν Il. 17.321, μόρον Il. 20.30, Il. 21.517 (see ὑπέρμορον, μόρος 3), μοῖραν Il. 20.336 : μόρον Od. 1.34, 35, Od. 5.436 (see ὑπέρμορον, μόρος 3). In reference to a person, in spite of, with . . . against one : ὑπὲρ θεόν Il. 17.327. 2 Genit. a In reference to position or height over or above something : ὑπὲρ κεφαλῆς Il. 2.20, ὅσον τʼ ὄργυιʼ ὑπὲρ αἴης Il. 23.327. Cf. Il. 13.200, etc. : Od. 4.803, Od. 6.107, Od. 12.406, Od. 16.471, etc. So in reference to the position of wound : βάλε στέρνον ὑπὲρ μαζοῖο Il. 4.528. Cf. Il. 5.145, Il. 13.616, Il. 15.433, etc. : Od. 19.450. To pouring water on hands held over a basin : χέρνιβα [χερσὶν] ἐπέχευεν ὑπὲρ ἀργυρέοιο λέβητος Od. 1.137, etc. In a navigational context, to the north of : ὑπὲρ κρήτης Od. 14.300 (cf. καθύπερθε 3..c). In reference to position far away over a space : τηλοῦ ὑπὲρ πόντου Od. 13.257. b In reference to motion passing over an object : ὥς τε κῦμα νηὸς ὑπὲρ τοίχων καταβήσεται Il. 15.382. Cf. Il. 12.424. Il. 14.412, Il. 16.406, Il. 20.279, Il. 23.73, 820, etc. : Od. 17.575. To the motion of sound : ὑπὲρ τάφρου ἴαχεν Il. 18.228. c In defence of, for the protection of : τεῖχος ἐτειχίσσαντο νεῶν ὕπερ Il. 7.449, etc. d On behalf of : ἑκατόμβην ῥέξαι ὑπὲρ Δαναῶν Il. 1.444. e On account of, concerning : ὅθʼ ὑπὲρ σέθεν αἴσχεʼ ἀκούω Il. 6.524. f In adjurations, by : ὑπὲρ τοκέων γουνούμενος Il. 15.660. Cf. Il. 15.665, Il. 22.338, Il. 24.466 : Od. 15.261.

u(gih/s.head: ὑγιής
u(gih/s.html: ὑγιής Sound, profitable : μῦθος Il. 8.524.

u(fi/sthmi.head: †ὑφίστημι
u(fi/sthmi.html: †ὑφίστημι [ὑφ-, ὑπο- 7.] Aor. ὑπέστην Il. 4.267, Il. 15.75, Il. 23.20, 180. 2 sing. ὑπέστης Il. 13.375 : Od. 9.365, Od. 10.483. 3 sing. ὑπέστη Il. 9.519, Il. 11.244, Il. 19.243, Il. 21.273. 1 pl. ὑπέστημεν Il. 5.715, Il. 19.195. 3 pl. ὑπέσταν Il. 2.286. 3 sing. opt. ὑποσταίη Il. 9.445. 3 sing. imp. ὑποστήτω Il. 9.160. Pple. ὑποστάς Il. 21.457 : Od. 3.99, Od. 4.329. 1 To come under an undertaking, give a promise, promise : ὡς τὸ πρῶτον ὑπέστην Il. 4.267. Cf. Il. 15.75 : Od. 9.365. With cognate acc. : ὑπόσχεσιν ἥν περ ὑπέσταν Il. 2.286. Cf. Il. 5.715 : Od. 10.483. With infin. of what one undertakes or promises to do : δῶρʼ, ὅσσʼ ὑπέστημεν δώσειν Il. 19.195. Cf. Il. 9.445. 2 To undertake to give, promise : τὰ δʼ ὄπισθεν ὑπέστη Il. 9.519. Cf. Il. 11.244, Il. 19.243, Il. 21.457. 3 To promise to perform, undertake : εἰ τελευτήσεις ὅσʼ ὑπέστης Il. 13.375. Cf. Il. 23.20 = 180 : Od. 3.99= Od. 4.329. 4 To make up one's mind to do something, bring oneself to do it (cf. τλάω 7 d ) : ὡς οὔ τίς με θεῶν ὑπέστη σαῶσαι (could find it in his heart to . . .) Il. 21.273. 5 To make admission, admit : ὑποστήτω μοι, ὅσσον βασιλεύτερός εἰμι Il. 9.160.

u(me/teros.head: ὑμέτερος
u(me/teros.html: ὑμέτερος -η, -ον [ὑμεῖς.] Your Il. 5.686, Il. 8.455, Il. 17.222, 226, Il. 20.116, Il. 23.84 : Od. 2.138, Od. 4.688, Od. 7.269, Od. 8.156, Od. 10.525, Od. 15.441, etc.

u(rtaki/dhs.head: Ὑρτακίδης
u(rtaki/dhs.html: Ὑρτακίδης Patronymic from next. Of Asius-2 Il. 2.837 , 838, Il. 12.96, 110, 163.

u(perbai/nw.head: ὑπερβαίνω
u(perbai/nw.html: ὑπερβαίνω [ὑπερ- 3.] 3 sing. aor. ὑπέρβη Od. 8.80, Od. 16.41, Od. 17.30, Od. 23.88. 3 pl. ὑπέρβασαν Il. 12.469. 3 sing. subj. ὑπερβήῃ Il. 9.501. 1 To pass or step over, pass, cross. With acc. : τεῖχος Il. 12.468, 469 : λάϊνον οὐδόν Od. 8.80, Od. 16.41, Od. 17.30, Od. 23.88. 2 To transgress, trespass, sin : ὄτε κέν τις ὑπερβήῃ Il. 9.501.

u(yhlo/s.head: ὑψηλός
u(yhlo/s.html: ὑψηλός -ή, -όν [ὕψι.] 1 Of great upward extent, high, lofty, tall : ἀκτῇ Il. 2.395, φηγῷ Il. 7.60. Cf. Il. 3.384, Il. 5.560, Il. 12.131, 282, 388, Il. 16.429, Il. 21.171, Il. 23.247, etc. : Od. 1.126, 330, Od. 6.58, Od. 8.422, Od. 9.183, Od. 16.285, Od. 21.51, Od. 22.176, etc. 2 Having a lofty position, high : ἀφʼ ὑψηλῆς κορυφῆς ὄρεος Il. 16.297 : μελάθρον Od. 11.278. Cf. Il. 2.855.

u(postre/fw.head: ὑποστρέφω
u(postre/fw.html: ὑποστρέφω [ὑπο- 10 12.] 3 pl. aor. subj. ὑποστρέψωσι Il. 12.71. 2 sing. opt. ὑποστρέψειας Il. 3.407. Pple. ὑποστρέψας Il. 11.446: Od. 8.301. Fut. infin. mid. ὑποστρέψεσθαι Od. 18.23. Aor. pple. pass. ὑποστρεφθείς Il. 11.567. 1 To wheel (one's horses) round in flight from the foe Il. 5.581. 2 In mid. and pass. a To turn oneself about, turn round, so as to face the foe: αὖτις ὑποστρεφθείς Il. 11.567. b To return, come back: ὑποστρέψεσθαι ἐς μέγαρον Ὀδυσῆος Od. 18.23. 3 Intrans. for reflexive a = 2.a: εἴ χʼ ὑποστρέψωσιν (turn upon us) Il. 12.71. b To turn oneself in a specified direction: φύγαδʼ αὖτις ὑποστρέψας Il. 11.446. c To turn back, turn on one's steps: αὖτις ὑποστρέψας Od. 8.301. d =2.b : μηδʼ ἔτʼ ὑποστρέψειας Ὄλυμπον (to . . .) Il. 3.407.

u(poxwre/w.head: ὑποχωρέω
u(poxwre/w.html: ὑποχωρέω [ὑπο- 12.] To retire or recoil in the face of danger : Ἀργεῖοι ὑπεχώρησαν Il. 6.107. Cf. Il. 13.476, Il. 22.96.

u(fai/nw.head: ὑφαίνω
u(fai/nw.html: ὑφαίνω [cf. ὑφάω.] Pa. iterative ὑφαίνεσκον Od. 19.149. 3 sing. ὑφαίνεσκε Od. 2.104, Od. 24.139. Aor. subj. ὑφήνω Od. 13.303. Imp. ὕφηνον Od. 13.386. Pple. ὑφήνας Od. 4.739. Fem. ὑφήνασα Od. 24.147. 1 To weave : ἱστόν Il. 3.125, Il. 6.456, Il. 22.440 : Od. 2.94= Od. 24.129, Od. 2.104= Od. 24.139, Od. 5.62, Od. 15.517, Od. 19.139, 149, Od. 24.147, φάρεα Od. 13.108. 2 Fig., to piece together in the mind, contrive, devise, develop : ὅτε μύθους καὶ μήδεα πᾶσιν ὕφαινον (developed them in the ears of the company) Il. 3.212, μῆτιν Il. 7.324= Il. 9.93. Cf. Il. 6.187 : Od. 4.678, 739, Od. 5.356, Od. 9.422, Od. 13.303, 386.

u(pei/rwn.head: Ὑπείρων
u(pei/rwn.html: Ὑπείρων Trojan. (ποιμὴν λαῶν). Killed by Diomedes Il. 5.144.

u(yhxh/s.head: ὑψηχής
u(yhxh/s.html: ὑψηχής [ὕψι + (app.) ἠχ- as in ἠχή.] Thus, as epithet of horses, loud-neighing Il. 5.772, Il. 23.27.

u(la/w.head: ὑλάω
u(la/w.html: ὑλάω 1 Of dogs, to bark or bay Od. 16.9, Od. 20.15. In mid. Od. 16.162. 2 To bark or bay at : οὐδʼ ὕλαον προσιόντα Od. 16.5.

u(yhrefh/s.head: ὑψηρεφής
u(yhrefh/s.html: ὑψηρεφής [ὕψι + ἐρέφω. Cf. ὑψερεφής, ὑψόροφος.] High-roofed, lofty : θαλάμοιο Il. 9.582.

u(yo/qi.head: ὑψόθι
u(yo/qi.html: ὑψόθι [ὑψ- as in ὕψι + -θι.] On high, high up, aloft : ὑ. ἐόντι Il. 10.16. Cf. Il. 17.676, Il. 19.376.

u(pera/llomai.head: †ὑπεράλλομαι
u(pera/llomai.html: †ὑπεράλλομαι [ὑπερ- 3.] 3 sing. aor. ὑπερᾶλτο Il. 20.327. Acc. sing. masc. pple. ὑπεράλμενον Il. 5.138. To leap or spring over. With genit. : αὐλῆς Il. 5.138. With acc. : πολλὰς στίχας Il. 20.327.

u(permenh/s.head: ὑπερμενής
u(permenh/s.html: ὑπερμενής [ὑπερ- 5 + μένος.] Of exceeding might or power, mighty, powerful. Epithet of Zeus Il. 2.116=Il. 9.23=Il. 14.69, Il. 2.350, 403, Il. 7.315, 481, Il. 8.470, Il. 11.727, Il. 13.226. Of kings Il. 8.236 : Od. 13.205, Od. 20.222. Of the Trojan allies Il. 16.362.

u(/ptios.head: ὕπτιος
u(/ptios.html: ὕπτιος [ὑπό.] On the back, supine (opposed to πρηνής) : ἄλλοθʼ ὕπτιος, ἄλλοτε δὲ πρηνής Il. 24.11. Cf. Il. 4.108, 522, Il. 7.145, 271, Il. 11.144, 179, Il. 12.192, Il. 13.548, Il. 15.434, 647, Il. 16.289, 863, Il. 17.523 : Od. 9.371, Od. 18.398.

u(yi/komos.head: ὑψίκομος
u(yi/komos.html: ὑψίκομος -ον [ὕψι + κόμη. Cf. κόμη 3.] Lofty and leafy (the second element being equivalent to a separate epithet; cf. οἰόζωνος Soph. O. T. 846, alone and girt up, journeying alone, πυκνόπτερος O. C. 17, many and winged. Cf. ὑψιπέτηλος) : δρυσίν Il. 14.398. Cf. Il. 23.118 : αὐλὴ δέδμητο δρυσὶν ὑψικόμοισιν Od. 9.186 (the second element here obscured, the reference being only to the length of the pieces of timber), δρυός Od. 12.357 (here referring especially to the wealth of foliage). Cf. Od. 14.328= Od. 19.297.

u(potre/w.head: ὑποτρέω
u(potre/w.html: ὑποτρέω [ὑπο- 12.] 2 sing. aor. ὑπέτρεσας Il. 17.587. 3 pl. ὑπέτρεσαν Il. 15.636, Il. 17.275. Infin. ὑποτρέσαι Il. 7.217. 1 To flee from the face of danger, take to flight, retreat, retire : νεκρὸν προλιπόντες ὑπέτρεσαν Il. 17.275. Cf. Il. 7.217, Il. 15.636. 2 To flee before the face of : Μενέλαον Il. 17.587.

u(perhsi/h.head: Ὑπερησίη
u(perhsi/h.html: Ὑπερησίη A town in Agamemnon's realm Il. 2.573. Ὑπερησίηνδε [-δε], to Hyperesia In reference to the flight of Polypheides hither Od. 15.254.

u(yo/rofos.head: ὑψόροφος
u(yo/rofos.html: ὑψόροφος [ὕψι + ὀροφή. Cf. ὑψηρεφής.] High-roofed, lofty : θάλαμον Il. 3.423. Cf. Il. 24.192, 317: Od. 2.337, Od. 4.121, Od. 5.42 = 115, Od. 7.77.

u(yibreme/ths.head: ὑψιβρεμέτης
u(yibreme/ths.html: ὑψιβρεμέτης [ὕψι + βρέμω.] High-thundering. Epithet of Zeus Il. 1.354, Il. 12.68, Il. 14.54, Il. 16.121 : Od. 5.4, Od. 23.331.

u(/w.head: ὕω
u(/w.html: ὕω To rain : ὗε Ζεύς Il. 12.25 : Od. 14.457. In pass., to be rained upon : ὑόμενος καὶ ἀήμενος Od. 6.131.

u(yo/qen.head: ὑψόθεν
u(yo/qen.html: ὑψόθεν [ὑψ- as in ὕψι + -θεν 1, -θεν 2.] 1 From a high or relatively high position, from on high, from above : βρόντησεν ὑ. Il. 20.57. Cf. Il. 11.53, Il. 12.383 : ὑ. ἐξ ὀροφῆς Od. 22.298. Cf. Od. 2.147, Od. 17.210, Od. 20.104. 2 On high, aloft : ἐκρέμω ὑ. Il. 15.18.

u(gro/s.head: ὑγρός
u(gro/s.html: ὑγρός -ή, -όν. 1 Fluid, liquid Il. 5.903. Sim. : ὑγρὰ κέλευθα (the watery ways) Il. 1.312 : = Od. 15.474, Od. 3.71 = Od. 9.252, Od. 4.842. Epithet of oil and water : ἔλαιον Il. 23.281 : Od. 6.79, 215, Od. 7.107, ὕδωρ Od. 4.458. 2 In neut. sing. ὑγρόν as adv. : ἀνέμων ὑ. ἀέντων (with rain, bringing rain) Od. 5.478, Od. 19.440. 3 Absol. in fem., (the) waters, (the) sea : ἐπὶ τραφερήν τε καὶ ὑγρήν Il. 14.308. Cf. Il. 10.27, Il. 24.341 : = Od. 1.97 = Od. 5.45, Od. 4.709, Od. 20.98.

u(pe/rqumos.head: ὑπέρθυμος
u(pe/rqumos.html: ὑπέρθυμος [ὑπερ- 5, ὑπερ- 6 + θυμός.] 1 Great-hearted, high-minded, bold, noble Il. 2.746, Il. 4.365, Il. 5.77, Il. 6.111, Il. 12.128, etc.: Od. 3.448, Od. 11.269, Od. 15.252. 2 Overweening, arrogant, wanton Il. 5.376: Od. 4.784, Od. 7.59, Od. 14.209, Od. 16.326 = 360.

u(pere/ptw.head: ὑπερέπτω
u(pere/ptw.html: ὑπερέπτω [ὑμ-, ὑπο- 1.] To eat away from under. With genit. , [ποταμὸς] κονίην ὑπέρεπτε ποδοῖιν Il. 21.271.

u(a/kinqos.head: ὑάκινθος
u(a/kinqos.html: ὑάκινθος Prob. the blue-bell, the wild hyacinth. Collectively Il. 14.348.

u(perku/das.head: ὑπερκύδας
u(perku/das.html: ὑπερκύδας -αντος [ὑπερ- 5 + κῦδος.] Far renowned, far famed. Epithet of the Achaeans Il. 4.66 = 71.

u(po/rrhnos.head: ὑπόρρηνος
u(po/rrhnos.html: ὑπόρρηνος -ον [ὑπο- 4 + *ϝρήν. See ἄρνα.] With a lamb at suck: ὄϊν Il. 10.216.

u(pofe/rw.head: †ὑποφέρω
u(pofe/rw.html: †ὑποφέρω [ὑπο- 3.] 3 pl. aor. ὑπήνεικαν. To bear away out of danger Il. 5.885.

u(pe/xw.head: †ὑπέχω
u(pe/xw.html: †ὑπέχω [ὑπ-, ὑπο- 4, ὑπο- 6.] Aor. pple. ὑποσχών Il. 5.269. 3 sing. aor. ὑπέσχεθε Il. 7.188. 1 To hold under something: χεῖρα Il. 7.188. 2 To submit (a female) to the male: ὑποσχὼν θήλεας ἵππους Il. 5.269.

u(fhni/oxos.head: ὑφηνίοχος
u(fhni/oxos.html: ὑφηνίοχος -ου, ὁ [ὑφ-, ὑπο- 5 + ἡνίοχος. Acting as driver under the fighting man.] = ἡνίοχος Il. 6.19.

u(pe/rmoron.head: ὑπέρμορον
u(pe/rmoron.html: ὑπέρμορον [use as adv. of neut. sing. of ὑπέρμορος fr. ὑπερ- 4 + μόρος. Also written ὑπὲρ μόρον.] See μόρος 3. Neut. pl. ὑπέρμορα in the same sense: Ἀργείοισί χʼ ὑ. νόστος ἐτύχθη Il. 2.155.

u(/patos.head: ὕπατος
u(/patos.html: ὕπατος -η, -ον [in form superl. fr. ὑπό.] 1 The topmost part of the . . ., the top of the . . .: ἐν πυρῇ ὑπάτῃ Il. 23.165, Il. 24.787. 2 Of Zeus, (the) highest, (the) supreme : ζῆνʼ ὕπατον κρονίδην Il. 5.756, κρονίδη, ὕπατε κρείοντων (supreme among . . .) Il. 8.31 : = Od. 1.45 = 81= Od. 24.473. Cf. Il. 8.22, Il. 17.339, Il. 23.43, Il. 19.258 : = Od. 19.303.

u(a/des.head: Ὑάδες
u(a/des.html: Ὑάδες The Hyades, a group of stars near the Pleiades Il. 18.486 .

u(pere/xw.head: ὑπερέχω
u(pere/xw.html: ὑπερέχω ὑπειρέχω [ὑπερ- 1.] 3 sing. aor. ὑπερέσχε Il. 9.420, 687 : Od. 13.93. 3 sing. subj. ὑπέρσχῃ Il. 4.249 : Od. 14.184. 3 sing. aor. ὑπερέσχεθε Il. 11.735, Il. 24.374. 1 To hold, keep in position, over. With genit. : σπλάγχνʼ ὑπείρεχον Ἡφαίστοιο Il. 2.426. 2 To hold or stretch (one's hand or hands) over a person in way of protection : αἴ κʼ ὔμμιν ὑπέρσχῃ χεῖρα Κρονίων Il. 4.249. Cf. Il. 5.433 : Od. 14.184. To hold or stretch thus (one's hand) over. With genit.: ἐμεῖό τις θεῶν ὑπερέσχεθε χεῖρα Il. 24.374. Cf. Il. 9.420 = 687. 3 Intrans. a To be above, exceed in height, overtop. With genit.: στάντων Μενέλαος ὑπείρεχεν ὤμους Il. 3.210 (στάντων app. referring to the whole assembly; ὤμους acc. of part concerned, with his . . .). b Of a heavenly body, to rise Od. 13.93. To rise or appear above (the earth). With genit.: εὐτʼ ἠέλιος ὑπερέσχεθε γαίης Il. 11.735.

u(poqh=bai.head: Ὑποθῆβαι
u(poqh=bai.html: Ὑποθῆβαι (ἐϋκτίμενον πτολίεθρον). A Boeotian town Il. 2.505.

u(yipeth/eis.head: ὑψιπετήεις
u(yipeth/eis.html: ὑψιπετήεις = ὑψιπέτης. Epithet of the eagle : αἰετός Il. 22.308 := Od. 24.538.

u(pa/gw.head: ὑπάγω
u(pa/gw.html: ὑπάγω [ὑπ-, ὑπο- 3, ὑπο- 8.] 1 To lead away from the range or reach of something : ἐκ βελέων ὕπαγεν Il. 11.163. 2 To lead (horses, etc.) under the yoke : ἡμιόνους ὕπαγον ζεῦξάν τε Od. 6.73. To lead (them) under (the yoke) and yoke them. With acc.: ὕπαγε (ὕπαγον) ζυγὸν ἵππους Il. 16.148, Il. 23.291, Il. 24.279.

u(smi/nh.head: ὑσμίνη
u(smi/nh.html: ὑσμίνη -ης, ἡ. Dat. ὑσμῖνι (fr. *ὑσμίς) Il. 2.863, Il. 8.56. 1 A fight or combat : ἐνὶ κρατερῇ ὑσμίνῃ Il. 4.462. Cf. Il. 2.40, Il. 5.84, Il. 11.72, Il. 13.314, Il. 16.567, Il. 20.245, etc. : Od. 11.417, 612. 2 In concrete sense, a fighting force, a battle array : ὑσμίνῃν ἤρτυνον Il. 15.303, κεδασθείσης ὑσμίνης (the ranks) 328= Il. 16.306. Cf. Il. 11.297, Il. 15.340, Il. 20.395.

u(peiroxi/dhs.head: Ὑπειροχίδης
u(peiroxi/dhs.html: Ὑπειροχίδης Patronymic of Itymoneus Il. 11.673.

u(poqermai/nw.head: †ὑποθερμαίνω
u(poqermai/nw.html: †ὑποθερμαίνω [ὑπο- 12.] 3 sing. aor. pass. ὑπεθερμάνθη. In pass., to become heated on the occurrence of something: ὑπεθερμάνθη ξίφος αἵματι (thereupon) Il. 16.333=Il. 20.476.

u(eto/s.head: ὑετός
u(eto/s.html: ὑετός -οῦ, ὁ [ὕω.] Rain Il. 12.133.

u(poura/nios.head: ὑπουράνιος
u(poura/nios.html: ὑπουράνιος [ὑπ-, ὑπο- 4 + οὐρανός.] Under heaven : πετεηνῶν Il. 17.675. As far as heaven covers : μέγα κέν οἱ ὑπουράνιον κλέος εἴη Il. 10.212 : τοῦ μέγιστον ὑπουράνιον κλέος ἐστίν Od. 9.264 (in these two passages in sense qualifying the vb.).

u(yipu/lh.head: Ὑψιπύλη
u(yipu/lh.html: Ὑψιπύλη Daughter of Thoas-2. By Ieson mother of Euneus Il. 7.469.

u(poku/omai.head: †ὑποκύομαι
u(poku/omai.html: †ὑποκύομαι [ὑπο- 6 + κύω = κυέω.] Aor. pple. fem. ὑποκυσαμένη Il. 6.26: Od. 11.254. Pl. ὑποκυσάμεναι Il. 20.225. To conceive under the act of the male, to conceive, become pregnant: ὑποκυσαμένη διδυμάονε γείνατο παῖδε Il. 6.26. Cf. Od. 11.254. Of mares Il. 20.225.

u(/pnos.head: ὕπνος
u(/pnos.html: ὕπνος -ου, ὁ. 1 Sleep Il. 1.610, Il. 2.2, Il. 5.413, Il. 13.636, Il. 22.502, etc.: Od. 1.363, Od. 2.398, Od. 4.105, Od. 7.318, Od. 9.372, etc. Personified Il. 14.231, 233, 242, 264, 270, 286, 354, Il. 16.454, 672 = 682. 2 Oppression caused by lack of sleep, heaviness, drowsiness: καμάτῳ ἀδηκότες ἠδὲ καὶ ὑπνῳ Il. 10.98. Cf. Od. 6.2, Od. 12.281.

u(perfi/alos.head: ὑπερφίαλος
u(perfi/alos.html: ὑπερφίαλος [ὑπερ- 6 + an unknown second element.] Heedless of the rights or feelings of others, careless of the consequences of one's actions, reckless, regardless: ἐπεί οἱ παῖδες ὑπερφίαλοί [εἰσιν] Il. 3.106. Cf. Il. 5.881, Il. 13.621, Il. 15.94, Il. 21.224, 414, 459, Il. 23.611: Od. 2.310, Od. 3.315=Od. 15.12, Od. 4.790, Od. 6.274, Od. 9.106, Od. 11.116, Od. 13.373, Od. 14.27, Od. 15.315, 376, Od. 16.271, Od. 18.167, Od. 20.12, 291, Od. 21.289, Od. 23.356. Absol.: ὑπερφιάλοισι μετελθών Od. 1.134. Of speech, rash, idle: ἔπος Od. 4.503, μύθους 774.

u(poli/zwn.head: ὑπολίζων
u(poli/zwn.html: ὑπολίζων -ονος [ὑπολιγίων, fr. ὑπο- 4 + ὀλιγίων, comp. fr. ὀλίγος.] Smaller than and under something else: λαοὶ ὑπολίζονες ἦσαν (were overtopped by the gods) Il. 18.519.

u(pe/rxomai.head: †ὑπέρχομαι
u(pe/rxomai.html: †ὑπέρχομαι [ὑπ-, ὑπο- 8 11.] 3 sing. aor. ὑπήλυθε Il. 7.215, Il. 20.44: Od. 5.476. 2 pl. ὑπήλθετε Od. 12.21. 3 sing. subj. ὑπέλθῃ Od. 18.150. To go or make one's way under or beneath, enter. With acc.: δοιοὺς θάμνους (slipped under them) Od. 5.476, μέλαθρον Od. 18.150. Cf. Od. 12.21. Fig.: Τρῶας τρόμος ὑπήλυθε γυῖα (γυῖα acc. of part affected, seized their limbs) Il. 7.215=Il. 20.44.

u(/bris.head: ὕβρις
u(/bris.html: ὕβρις ἡ. Wanton disregard of decency or of the rights or feelings of others, an overbearing or domineering spirit or demeanour, a spirit of wanton aggression or violence, wantonness, violence : τῶν ὕβρις οὐρανὸν ἵκει Od. 15.329 = Od. 17.565. Cf. Od. 1.368 = Od. 4.321, Od. 4.627 = Od. 17.169, Od. 14.262 = Od. 17.431, Od. 16.86, 410, 418, Od. 17.487, 581, Od. 23.64, Od. 24.352. A manifestation of such a spirit : ὕβριος εἵνεκα τῆσδε (this insult) Il. 1.214. Cf. Il. 1.203.

u(pode/xomai.head: †ὑποδέχομαι
u(pode/xomai.html: †ὑποδέχομαι [ὑπο- 4, ὑπο- 5 7 12.] Fut. ὑποδέξομαι Il. 18.59, 440: Od. 16.70, Od. 19.257. 2 sing. ὑποδέξεαι Il. 18.89. 3 sing. aor. ὑπεδέξατο Il. 6.136, Il. 18.398: Il. 22.470. 2 sing. aor. ὑπέδεξο Od. 14.54. 3 sing. ὑπέδεκτο Il. 9.480: Od. 2.387, Od. 14.52, Od. 20.372, Od. 23.314. Infin. ὑποδέχθαι Il. 7.93. Pf. pple. ὑποδέγμενος Od. 13.310, Od. 16.189. 3 sing. plupf. ὑπέδεκτο Od. 14.275. 1 To receive, catch: θέτις ὑπεδέξατο κόλπῳ δειδιότα Il. 6.136. Cf. Il. 18.398. To receive, take in: στυγερὸς ὑπεδέξατο κοῖτος Od. 22.470. 2 To receive, welcome: τὸν οὐχ ὑποδέξομαι (ὑποδέξεαι) αὖτις οἴκαδε νοστήσαντα Il. 18.59= 440, Il. 18.89: Od. 19.257. To receive hospitably, take under one's care or protection: πρόφρων μʼ ὑπέδεκτο Il. 9.480. Cf. Od. 14.52, 54, Od. 16.70, Od. 20.372, Od. 23.314. 3 To accept or take up a challenge: δεῖσαν ὑποδέχθαι Il. 7.93. 4 To undertake to grant a request, promise something: ὅ οἱ πρόφρων ὑπέδεκτο Od. 2.387. 5 In plupf. and pf. pple. a To submit to, put up with, endure: βίας ὑποδέγμενος ἀνδρῶν Od. 13.310, Od. 16.189. b To await, be laid up for or destined to: ἔτι με πῆμʼ ὑπέδεκτο Od. 14.275.

u(a/mpolis.head: Ὑάμπολις
u(a/mpolis.html: Ὑάμπολις A town of Phocis Il. 2.521.

u(rmi/nh.head: Ὑρμίνη
u(rmi/nh.html: Ὑρμίνη A town of Elis Il. 2.616 .

u(porrh/gnumi.head: †ὑπορρήγνυμι
u(porrh/gnumi.html: †ὑπορρήγνυμι [ὑπο- 1.] 3 sing. aor. pass. ὑπερράγη. To rend or cleave from beneath something: ὑπερράγη αἰθήρ Il. 8.558=Il. 16.300 (i.e. (the cloud-bank in) the upper air is rent away from beneath the sources of light).

u(poti/qhmi.head: †ὑποτίθημι
u(poti/qhmi.html: †ὑποτίθημι [ὑπο- 11.] Fut. mid. ὑποθήσομαι Od. 1.279, Od. 2.194, Od. 5.143. 2 sing. ὑποθήσεαι Od. 4.163. 3 sing. ὑποθήσεται Od. 3.27. 1 pl. ὑποθησόμεθα Il. 8.36, 467, Il. 21.293. Aor. imp. ὑπόθευ Od. 15.310. Infin. ὑποθέσθαι Il. 11.788. In mid., to put into a person's mind, suggest, communicate (cf. τίθημι 5) : ἄλλα δαίμων ὑποθήσεται Od. 3.27. Cf. Il. 8.36 = 467, Il. 11.788 : Od. 4.163. Absol., to make a suggestion, give advice or counsel : πυκινῶς τοι ὑποθησόμεθα Il. 21.293. Cf. Od. 1.279, Od. 2.194, Od. 5.143, Od. 15.310.

u(permene/wn.head: ὑπερμενέων
u(permene/wn.html: ὑπερμενέων -οντος [ὑπερμενής in bad sense.] Overweening, overbearing, arrogant : ἄνδρες Od. 19.62.

u(/dh.head: Ὕδη
u(/dh.html: Ὕδη (πίων). Apparently a district of Maeonia (Μῃονίη) Od. 3.385.

u(lagmo/s.head: ὑλαγμός
u(lagmo/s.html: ὑλαγμός -οῦ, ὁ [ὑλακ- as in ὑλακτέω.] A barking or baying Il. 21.575.

u(pwro/fios.head: ὑπωρόφιος
u(pwro/fios.html: ὑπωρόφιος [ὑπ-, ὑπο- 4 + ὀροφή.] Under one's roof : ὑπωρόφιοί τοί εἰμεν Il. 9.640.

u(perhfane/w.head: ὑπερηφανέω
u(perhfane/w.html: ὑπερηφανέω [ὑπερ- 6 + an uncertain second element.] App., to conceive arrogance, be led on to arrogance or wantonness: ταῦθʼ ὑπερηφανέοντες (ταῦτα advbl., by these things) Il. 11.694.

u(podra/w.head: †ὑποδράω
u(podra/w.html: †ὑποδράω [ὑπο- 5.] 3 pl. ὑποδρώωσι. To serve under a master, be servant or minister: οἵ σφιν ὑποδρώωσιν Od. 15.333.

u(pw/reia.head: ὑπώρεια
u(pw/reia.html: ὑπώρεια ἡ [ὑπ-, ὑπο- 4 + ὄρος.] A region skirting or fringing a mountain Il. 20.218.

u(/llos.head: Ὕλλος
u(/llos.html: Ὕλλος (ἰχθυόεις). A river of Maeonia (Μῃονίη) flowing into the Hermus Od. 3.392.

u(poqhmosu/nh.head: ὑποθημοσύνη
u(poqhmosu/nh.html: ὑποθημοσύνη -ης, ἡ [ὑποτίθημι.] Suggestion, instance. In pl.: ὑποθημοσύνῃσιν Ἀθήνης Od. 16.233. Inspiration. In pl.: ὑποθημοσύνῃσιν Ἀθήνης Il. 15.412.

u(pe/rbios.head: ὑπέρβιος
u(pe/rbios.html: ὑπέρβιος -ον [ὑπερ- 6 + βίη.] 1 Headlong, headstrong, not to be restrained or turned aside Il. 18.262 : Od. 15.212. 2 Overweening, arrogant, wanton : ὕβριν Od. 1.368=Od. 4.321, Od. 16.410. In neut. ὑπέρβιον as adv., in overweening wise, wantonly, recklessly : βοῦς μευ ἔκτειναν ὑ. Od. 12.379. Cf. Il. 17.19 : Od. 14.92, 95, Od. 16.315.

u(yerefh/s.head: ὑψερεφής
u(yerefh/s.html: ὑψερεφής -ές [ὕψι + ἐρέφω. Cf. ὑψηρεφής.] Highroofed, lofty : δῶμα Il. 5.213, Il. 19.333 := Od. 7.225= Od. 19.526, Od. 4.15, 46, Od. 7.85, Od. 15.241. Cf. Od. 4.757, Od. 10.111 = Od. 15.424, Od. 13.5, Od. 15.432.

u(perqrw/|skw.head: †ὑπερθρῴσκω
u(perqrw/|skw.html: †ὑπερθρῴσκω [ὑπερ- 3.] 3 pl. fut. in mid. form ὑπερθορέονται Il. 8.179. Aor. ὑπέρθορον Il. 9.476. 3 pl. ὑπέρθορον Il. 16.380. Infin. ὑπερθορέειν Il. 12.53. To leap or spring over. With acc.: τάφρον Il. 8.179, Il. 16.380. Cf. Il. 9.476. Absol. Il. 12.53.

u(pe/roplos.head: ὑπέροπλος
u(pe/roplos.html: ὑπέροπλος [ὑπερ- 6 + an unknown second element.] Insolent, arrogant. In neut. sing. ὑπέροπλον as adv., insolently, arrogantly : ἔειπεν Il. 15.185. Cf. Il. 17.170.

u(pei/roxos.head: ὑπείροχος
u(pei/roxos.html:
ὑπείροχος [ὑπειρ-, ὑπερ- 5 + ὀχ-, ἔχω.] Pre-eminent, prominent : ὑπείροχον ἔμμεναι ἄλλων (among . . .) Il. 6.208 = Il. 11.784.
Ὑπείροχος Trojan. killed by Odysseus Il. 11.335.

u(/rtios.head: Ὕρτιος
u(/rtios.html: Ὕρτιος Patronymic Γυρτιάδης. A leader of the Mysians-1. Killed by Aias-1 Il. 14.511.

u(pai/ssw.head: †ὑπαΐσσω
u(pai/ssw.html: †ὑπαΐσσω [ὑπ-, ὑπο- 1, ὑπο- 9.] 3 sing. fut. ὑπᾶΐξει Il. 21.126. Aor. pple. ὑπαΐξας Il. 2.310. 1 To dart from under. With genit. : βωμοῦ Il. 2.310. 2 To dart along beneath. With acc. : φρῖκα Il. 21.126.

u(pe/rtatos.head: ὑπέρτατος
u(pe/rtatos.html: ὑπέρτατος [superl. fr. ὑπέρ.] In the highest position : μαρμάρῳ, ὃ κεῖτο ὑ. (on the top of a heap) Il. 12.381, ἧστο ὑ. (raised above the others) Il. 23.451.

u(/dros.head: ὕδρος
u(/dros.html: ὕδρος -ου, ὁ [ὕδωρ.] A water-snake Il. 2.723.

ui(o/s.head: υἱός
ui(o/s.html: υἱός -οῦ, ὁ. (The first syllable shortened Il. 1.489, Il. 4.473, Il. 5.612, Il. 6.130, Il. 7.47, Il. 9.84, Il. 16.21, etc. : Od. 11.270, 478.) Also, fr. stem υἱυ-, genit. υἱέος Il. 24.122 : Od. 3.489, Od. 4.4, Od. 11.174, Od. 15.187, Od. 18.162. Dat. υἱέϊ Il. 3.174, Il. 15.455, Il. 20.81, Il. 21.141, Il. 24.112 : Od. 3.369, Od. 4.5, 10, Od. 16.438, 452, Od. 23.61, Od. 24.213. υἱεῖ Il. 18.144, 458 : Od. 14.435. Acc. υἱέα Il. 13.350. Nom. pl. υἱέες Il. 2.641, 666, Il. 5.10, Il. 11.138, 692, Il. 16.449, Il. 24.604 : Od. 10.6, Od. 14.201, Od. 19.414, 430, 437, 459. υἱεῖς Od. 15.248, Od. 24.387, 497. Acc. υἱέας Il. 2.693, Il. 5.149, Il. 11.123, Il. 23.175, 181, Il. 24.205, 521 : Od. 4.211. Voc. pl. υἱεῖς Il. 5.464. And fr. this stem by hyphaeresis genit. υἷος Il. 2.230, Il. 5.266, Il. 13.522, Il. 14.9, Il. 15.116, 138, Il. 18.138, Il. 19.324, Il. 23.746, Il. 24.422, 550 : Od. 11.452, Od. 17.397, Od. 20.218. Dat. υἷι Il. 2.20, 791, Il. 13.216, Il. 16.177, Il. 21.34, Il. 22.302, Il. 23.383 : Od. 4.143, 771, Od. 11.273. Acc. υἷα Il. 12.129, Il. 13.185, 792, Il. 15.419, 427 : Od. 4.765, Od. 13.259, Od. 20.35. Nom. dual υἰῖ Il. 2.679, 822, 831, 843, 865, Il. 12.95, 99, Il. 13.345. Acc. υἷε Il. 5.27, 152, 542, Il. 11.102, 329, Il. 20.460 : Od. 15.242. Nom. pl. υἷες Il. 1.162, Il. 2.253, Il. 4.114, Il. 6.255, Il. 7.403, Il. 10.165, Il. 13.146, Il. 15.675, Il. 16.56, Il. 17.23, Il. 18.444, Il. 21.376, Il. 24.399, etc. : Od. 2.51, Od. 3.104, Od. 4.285, Od. 6.62, Od. 8.514, Od. 13.315, Od. 23.220, Od. 24.38, etc. Dat. υἱάσι, Il. 5.463, Il. 15.197, Il. 24.248, 546 : Od. 3.32, 57, 387, Od. 10.7, Od. 14.206, Od. 17.113, Od. 19.466, Od. 21.220. Acc. υἷας Il. 1.240, Il. 2.72, Il. 5.159, Il. 9.40, Il. 10.49, Il. 12.128, Il. 14.106, Il. 18.76, Il. 19.156, Il. 22.62, Il. 24.189, etc. : Od. 2.115, 198, Od. 14.229, Od. 19.394, Od. 22.221. A son, one's son Il. 1.9, Il. 2.20, Il. 3.174, Il. 4.89, Il. 5.10, Il. 6.154, etc. : Od. 1.88, Od. 2.2, Od. 3.57, Od. 4.4, Od. 5.28, Od. 6.62, etc. Of warriors : υἷες Ἄρηος Il. 2.512, Il. 9.82.–υἷες Ἀχαιῶν, the sons of the Achaeans, the AchaeansIl. 1.162, Il. 2.72, Il. 4.114, Il. 6.255, etc. : Od. 2.115, Od. 3.104, Od. 4.285, Od. 8.514, etc. Sim. : Τρώων καὶ Ἀχαιῶν υἶες Od. 24.38.

u(pome/nw.head: †ὑπομένω
u(pome/nw.html: †ὑπομένω [ὑπο- 12 (the prefix in the first sense app. pointing vaguely the contrast with those who do not remain).] Aor. ὑπέμεινα Od. 10.258. 3 sing. ὑπέμεινε Il. 14.488, Il. 16.814, Il. 17.25 : Od. 1.410, Od. 10.232. 3 pl. ὑπέμειναν Il. 5.498, Il. 15.312. Infin. ὑπομεῖναι Il. 17.174. 1 To remain where one is, stay behind: εὐρύλοχος ὑπέμεινεν Od. 10.232. Cf. Od. 10.258. To remain or stay for some purpose. With infin.: οὐδʼ ὑπέμεινε γνώμεναι (for one to know him) Od. 1.410. 2 To await the onset of (an attacking foe), stand up to (him): Πάτροκλον Il. 16.814. Cf. Il. 17.25, 174. Sim.: ἐρωὴν πηνελέωο Il. 14.488. Absol., to await the foe, stand firm, stand one's ground: Ἀργεῖοι ὑπέμειναν ἀολλέες Il. 5.498, Il. 15.312.

u(poba/llw.head: ὑποβάλλω
u(poba/llw.html: ὑποβάλλω ὑββάλλω [ὑπο- 8.] 1 To put underneath: ὑπένερθε λῖθʼ ὑπέβαλλεν Od. 10.353. 2 To throw in one's word, interrupt a speaker: ἑσταότος μὲν καλὸν ἀκουέμεν, οὐδὲ ἔοικεν ὑββάλλειν Il. 19.80 (rejecting 77; if it be retained the sense must be to prompt another, put him up as one's mouthpiece).

u(yika/rhnos.head: ὑψικάρηνος
u(yika/rhnos.html: ὑψικάρηνος -ον [ὕψι + κάρηνον.] Rearing the head aloft, lofty : δρύες Il. 12.132.

u(perkatabai/nw.head: †ὑπερκαταβαίνω
u(perkatabai/nw.html: †ὑπερκαταβαίνω [ὑπερ- 3 + κατα- 1.] 3 pl. aor. ὑπερκατέβησαν. To pass over and descend from, pass, cross. With acc. : τεῖχος Il. 13.50, 87.

u(perpe/tomai.head: †ὑπερπέτομαι
u(perpe/tomai.html: †ὑπερπέτομαι [ὑπερ- 2, ὑπερ- 3.] 3 sing. aor. ὑπέρπτατο. To fly over something. Of a missile : ὑπέρπτατο ἔγχος Il. 13.408, Il. 22.275 : Od. 22.280. To fly over or beyond. With acc.: δίσκος ὑπέρπτατο σήματα πάντων Od. 8.192.

u(/statos.head: ὕστατος
u(/statos.html: ὕστατος [superl. Cf. ὕστερος.] 1 In reference to position, the least advanced in an indicated direction, the last : οἱ πρῶτοί τε καὶ ὕστατοι Il. 2.281. Cf. Il. 13.459. 2 a Being the last to do something, last : ὕστατος λάχʼ ἐλαυνέμεν ἵππους Il. 23.356 (i.e. his lot came out last, which would give him the outside place) : ὕστατος μήλων ἔστειχεν Od. 9.444. Cf. Od. 9.448. b Sim. in oblique case of that to which action is last directed, last : τίνα ὕστατον ἐξενάριξαν; Il. 5.703. Cf. Il. 11.299, Il. 16.692. 3 a In neut. sing. ὕστατον as adv., for the last time : τότε γʼ ὑ. Od. 12.250. With πύματον in the same sense : πύματόν τε καὶ ὑ. Il. 22.203 : Od. 20.116. b So in neut. pl. ὕστατα : νῦν ὕστατʼ ἂν λωβήσαιο Il. 1.232= Il. 2.242. Cf. Od. 20.119, Od. 22.78 = 134. With πύματα in the same sense : ὕστατα καὶ πύματα Od. 4.685, Od. 20.13.

u(pekproqe/w.head: ὑπεκπροθέω
u(pekproqe/w.html: ὑπεκπροθέω [ὑπ-, ὑπο- 3 + ἐκ- 1 + προ- 1.] To run forward out from among, outstrip : Ἄτη πάσας πολλὸν ὑπεκπροθέει Il. 9.506. Absol.: τὸν διώκετο τυτθὸν ὑπεκπροθέοντα (keeping ever a little in front) Il. 21.604: τόσσον ὑπεκπροθέων λαοὺς ἵκετο (running forward out of the ruck) Od. 8.125.

u(yo/se.head: ὑψόσε
u(yo/se.html: ὑψόσε [ὑψ- as in ὕψι + -σε.] To a high or relatively high position, high, up, upwards : ἀπὸ χθονὸς ὑ. ἔεργεν Il. 14.349, ὑ. αὐγὴ γίγνεται Il. 18.211. Cf. Il. 10.461, 465, 505, Il. 11.307, Il. 12.138, Il. 20.325, Il. 21.269, 302, 307, 324, Il. 22.34, Il. 23.501 : Od. 8.375, Od. 9.240 = 340, Od. 12.238, 249, 432, Od. 13.83, Od. 19.38, Od. 22.467.

u(polei/pw.head: ὑπολείπω
u(polei/pw.html: ὑπολείπω [ὑπο- 12 (the prefix app. pointing vaguely the contrast with what does not remain).] Fut. pass. ὑπολείψομαι Od. 17.276, 282, Od. 19.44. 1 To leave remaining or unconsumed; in pass., to remain, be left: πέμπτον ὑπελείπετʼ ἄεθλον Il. 23.615: ἃ τῇ προτέρῃ ὑπέλειπον ἔδοντες Od. 16.50. 2 In pass., to be left behind, remain, while another departs: ἐν μεγάρῳ ὑπελείπετʼ Ὀδυσεύς Od. 7.230=Od. 19.1 = 51. Cf. Od. 17.276, 282, Od. 19.44.

u(/dwr.head: ὕδωρ
u(/dwr.html: ὕδωρ -ατος, τό [cf. L. unda, Eng. water.] (The υ freq. lengthened metrically.) 1 Water Il. 2.307, Il. 3.270, Il. 6.457, Il. 7.99, Il. 9.15, etc. : Od. 1.110, Od. 3.429, Od. 4.213, Od. 5.70, Od. 6.86, Od. 9.209, etc. Of a flood of water : ἀλὲν ὑ. ἐξέρρηξεν ὁδοῖο Il. 23.420. 2 In various specific applications. a A river : σχεδόν ὕδατος Od. 5.475. Cf. Il. 21.14. The waters of a river : τιταρησσόν, ὅς ῥʼ ἐς πηνειὸν προΐει ὑ. Il. 2.752. Cf. Il. 2.755, 850, Il. 8.369, Il. 21.21, etc. : Od. 4.478, Od. 5.185, Od. 10.514. Of the waters of two or more rivers : ὡς ὅτε ποταμοὶ συμβάλλετον ὑ. (their waters) Il. 4.453, ὥς τε πρὼν ἰσχάνει ὑ. Il. 17.747 (= ποταμῶν ῥέεθρα 749). Cf. Il. 12.33. b A spring of water : ὕδατʼ ἀενάοντα Od. 13.109. Cf. Od. 12.306. c A pond : χῆνες πυρὸν ἔδουσιν ἐξ ὕδατος (coming from their . . .) Od. 19.537. d Rain : ὅτε λαβρότατον χέει ὑ. Ζεύς Il. 16.385. e The sea, the wave of the sea : Αἰγύπτῳ ἐπέλασσεν ἄνεμός τε καὶ ὑ. Od. 3.300. Cf. Od. 7.277, Od. 15.482. The water of the sea : ἀλμυρὸν ὑ. Od. 4.511. Cf. Od. 12.104, 172, 236, etc.

u(pekprofeu/gw.head: †ὑπεκπροφεύγω
u(pekprofeu/gw.html: †ὑπεκπροφεύγω [ὑπ-, ὑπο- 3 + ἐκ- 1 + προ- 1.] Aor. opt. ὑπεκπροφύγοιμι Od. 12.113, Od. 20.43. Pple. ὑπεκπροφυγών Il. 20.147, Il. 21.44. To get away from the power or reach of, and make good one's escape : εἴ πως ὑπεκπροφύγοιμι χάρυβδιν Od. 12.113. Absol., to get away from the power or reach of something or from restraint and make good one's escape: ὄφρα τὸ κῆτος ὑπεκπροφυγὼν ἀλέαιτο Il. 20.147. Cf. Il. 21.44 : πῇ κεν ὑπεκπροφύγοιμι; (i.e. from the relatives of the slain men) Od. 20.43.

u(ri/h.head: Ὑρίη
u(ri/h.html: Ὑρίη A Boeotian town on the Euripus Il. 2.496.

u(/peimi.head: †ὕπειμι
u(/peimi.html: †ὕπειμι [ὑπ-, ὑπο- 4 + εἰμί.] 3 pl. pres. ὑπέσι Il. 9.204. 3 pl. impf. ὑπῆσαν Il. 11.681. To be under. With dat. : ἐμῷ μελάθρῳ Il. 9.204, πολλῇσιν [ἵπποισι] πῶλοι ὑπῆσαν (many had sucking foals) Il. 11.681.

u(yi/zugos.head: ὑψίζυγος
u(yi/zugos.html: ὑψίζυγος [ὕψι + ζυγόν. Cf. ζυγόν 2.] Seated aloft. Epithet of Zeus Il. 4.166, Il. 7.69, Il. 11.544, Il. 18.185.

ui(wno/s.head: υἱωνός
ui(wno/s.html: υἱωνός -οῦ, ὁ [υἱός.] A grandson, one's grandson Il. 2.666, Il. 5.631, Il. 13.207 : Od. 24.515.

u(pe/k.head: ὑπέκ
u(pe/k.html: ὑπέκ before a vowel ὑπέξ [ὑπό + ἐκ, ἐξ.] 1 Adv. Out of the power, range or reach of something : ὄφρʼ (ἵνʼ) ὑπὲκ κακότητα φύγοιμεν Od. 3.175, Od. 9.489 = Od. 10.129. 2 Prep. with genit. a From under or beneath, away from under or beneath : ἵππους λύσαθʼ ὑπὲξ ὀχέων Il. 8.504, τείχεος αἰὲν ὑπὲκ κατʼ ἀμαξιτὸν ἐσσεύοντο (app. to get the better going afforded by the road) Il. 22.146. Up from out of : ἀγέροντο ψυχαὶ ὑπὲξ Ἐρέβευς Od. 11.37. App., up away from : ἔγχος ὦσεν ὑπὲκ δίφροιο Il. 5.854. b In reference to saving or escaping, from out of, out of the reach or range of, away from, from : ὑπὲκ βελέων Il. 4.465, Il. 18.232. Cf. Il. 13.89, Il. 15.628, 700, Il. 17.461, 581, 589, Il. 20.300 : Od. 12.107. Sim. in reference to carrying off from a protector : [ἄρνας] ὑπὲκ μήλων αἱρεύμενοι Il. 16.353.

u(pekfeu/gw.head: †ὑπεκφεύγω
u(pekfeu/gw.html: †ὑπεκφεύγω [ὑπ-, ὑπο- 3 + ἐκ- 1.] Aor. ὑπέκφυγον Od. 9.286, Od. 12.446. 2 sing. ὑπέκφυγες Il. 20.191. 3 sing. ὑπεξέφυγε Il. 8.369, Il. 22.202. ὑπέκφυγε Il. 5.22, Il. 16.687 : Od. 23.320. 3 pl. ὑπεξέφυγον Od. 11.383. 3 sing. opt. ὑπεκφύγοι Il. 6.57 : Od. 12.287, Od. 16.372, Od. 20.368. Infin. ὑπεκφυγέειν Il. 8.243 : Od. 12.216. 1 To keep away from the power or reach of, escape, avoid, shun (impending danger) : κῆρα Il. 5.22, Il. 16.687. Cf. Il. 6.57, Il. 22.202: Od. 9.286, Od. 12.216, 287, 446, Od. 16.372, Od. 20.368. 2 To get away, effect one's escape, from (danger in which one is involved) : Τρώων ἀϋτήν Od. 11.383. Cf. Il. 8.369. 3 Absol., to effect one's escape, escape, save oneself: ἐς Λυρνησσόν Il. 20.191. Cf. Il. 8.243 : Od. 23.320.

u(fe/lkw.head: ὑφέλκω
u(fe/lkw.html: ὑφέλκω [ὑφ-, ὑπο- 3.] To draw out of the reach of the foe Il. 14.477.

u(perwe/w.head: ὑπερωέω
u(perwe/w.html: ὑπερωέω [ὑπ-, ὑπο- 12 + ἐρωέω2.] To start back under stress of something: ὑπερώησάν οἱ ἵπποι (thereat, in terror) Il. 8.122= 314= Il. 15.452.

u(/yi.head: ὕψι
u(/yi.html: ὕψι [cf. ὑψοῦ.] 1 On high, aloft : ὕψι καθημένω Od. 16.264. Cf. Il. 15.387, Il. 20.155, Il. 23.874. 2 To a high or relatively high position, to a great height, high : ἀναθρῴσκων Il. 13.140. Cf. Il. 16.374, Il. 17.723. Stepping high : βιβάντα Il. 13.371. 3 Afloat (cf. ὑψοῦ(3)) : ὕψι ἐπʼ εὐνάων ὁρμίσσομεν [νῆας] Il. 14.77.

u(pantia/w.head: †ὑπαντιάω
u(pantia/w.html: †ὑπαντιάω [ὑπ-, ὑπο- 12.] Aor. pple. ὑπαντιάσας. To meet an attacking foe : οὔ τις ἤρκεσεν ὄλεθρον πρόσθεν ὑπαντιάσας (taking his stand before him and meeting the foe) Il. 6.17.

u(pofeu/gw.head: ὑποφεύγω
u(pofeu/gw.html: ὑποφεύγω [ὑπο- 12.] To flee before (a foe) : οὐ τὸν δύναται ὑποφεύγειν Il. 22.200.

u(/lh.head: ὕλη
u(/lh.html:
ὕλη -ης, ἡ. 1 A wood or forest Il. 3.151, Il. 6.147, Il. 12.148, Il. 15.273, Il. 18.320, etc. : Od. 5.63, 470, 475, Od. 6.128, Od. 10.159, Od. 14.353. 2 Woodlands, woods : ἄγρια, τά τε τρέφει οὔρεσιν ὑ. Il. 5.52. Cf. Il. 5.555, Il. 11.118, Il. 13.18, 102, etc. : ὄρος καταειμένον ὕλῃ (with wood) Od. 13.351, Od. 19.431. Cf. Od. 5.398, Od. 9.120, Od. 10.150, 197, Od. 13.246, Od. 17.316. 3 Lop, the smaller branches of felled timber : πολλὴν ἐπεχεύατο ὕλην Od. 5.257. Such branches used as fuel, firewood, faggot-wood : ἕτεροι μεθʼ ὕλην Il. 7.418, 420. Cf.Il. 23.50, 111, 127, 139, 163, 198, Il. 24.662, 784 : Od. 9.234, Od. 10.104.
Ὕλη (ῦ). A Boeotian town Il. 2.500, Il. 5.708, Il. 7.221.

u(potrome/w.head: ὑποτρομέω
u(potrome/w.html: ὑποτρομέω [ὑπο- 12.] 3 pl. pa. iterative ὑποτρομέεσκον Il. 20.28. 1 To tremble on account of something, be affected by fear, show fear : τοῖον ὑποτρομέουσιν Il. 22.241. 2 To tremble before, be in fear of, dread : μιν Il. 20.28.

u(yh/nwr.head: Ὑψήνωρ-1
u(yh/nwr.html:
Ὑψήνωρ-1 Trojan. (δῖος). Son of Dolopion. Killed by Eurypylus-2 Il. 5.76.
Ὑψήνωρ-2 Greek. (ποιμὴν λαῶν). Patronymic Ἱππασίδης-2. Mortally wounded by Deiphobus Il. 13.411.

u(pofh/ths.head: ὑποφήτης
u(pofh/ths.html: ὑποφήτης ὁ [ὑπο- 12 + φημί.] One who gives an interpretative response in regard to or reveals the oracles of a god, a prophet Il. 16.235.

u(postenaxi/zw.head: ὑποστεναχίζω
u(postenaxi/zw.html: ὑποστεναχίζω [ὑπο- 12.] To give forth a heavy sound, rumble, on the occurrence of something: γαῖα ὑπεστενάχιζεν (thereupon, thereat) Il. 2.781.

u(posxesi/h.head: ὑποσχεσίη
u(posxesi/h.html: ὑποσχεσίη -ης, ἡ [as ὑπόσχεσις.] = ὑπόσχεσις. Il. 13.369.

u(podeci/h.head: ὑποδεξίη
u(podeci/h.html: ὑποδεξίη ἡ [ὑποδέχομαι.] Hospitable entertainment, hospitality: πᾶσά τοί ἐσθʼ ὑποδεξίη (it is for thee to offer all hospitality) Il. 9.73.

u(pokru/ptw.head: †ὑποκρύπτω
u(pokru/ptw.html: †ὑποκρύπτω [ὑπο- 4.] 3 sing. aor. pass. ὑπεκρύφθη. To hide or cover up under or beneath. With dat.: νηῦς ἄχνῃ ὑπεκρύφθη Il. 15.626.

u(mo/s.head: ὑμός
u(mo/s.html: ὑμός -ή, -όν [ὑμεῖς.] Your Il. 5.489, Il. 13.815 : Od. 9.284. Your own : κτήματα Od. 1.375 = Od. 2.140.

u(bri/zw.head: ὑβρίζω
u(bri/zw.html: ὑβρίζω [ὕβρις.] (ἐφ-) 1 To show ὕβρις, act without regard to right or decency, exhibit an overbearing spirit or demeanour, bear oneself with wantonness : ὑβρίζοντες ἀτάσθαλα μηχανόωνται Od. 3.207. Cf.Od. 1.227, Od. 17.245, 588, Od. 18.381. With cognate acc. : λώβην, ἣν ὅδʼ ὑβρίζοντες . . . Od. 20.170. 2 To treat with wanton despite, maltreat Il. 11.695 : Od. 20.370.

u(phoi=os.head: ὑπηοῖος
u(phoi=os.html: ὑπηοῖος -η, -ον [ὑπ-, ὑπο- 12 + ἠώς.] 1 Of the dawn, the morning. . . : στίβη Od. 17.25. 2 With the dawn, at break of day: πρῶϊ ὑπηοῖοι ἐγείρομεν Ἄρηα (στησόμεθʼ ἂμ πύργους) Il. 8.530=Il. 18.277 = 303. In neut. ὑπηοῖον as adv. in the same sense: χθιζὸν ὑ. Od. 4.656.

u(potarbe/w.head: ὑποταρβέω
u(potarbe/w.html: ὑποταρβέω [ὑπο- 12.] To feel fear or dread before the face of : τοὺς ὑποταρβήσαντες (struck with terror at their appearance) Il. 17.533.

u(loto/mos.head: ὑλοτόμος
u(loto/mos.html: ὑλοτόμος [ὕλη + τομ-, τάμνω.] 1 Fitted for cutting or felling wood : πελέκεας Il. 23.114. 2 As sb., a wood-cutter Il. 23.123.

u(/rtakos.head: Ὕρτακος
u(/rtakos.html: Ὕρτακος Father of Asius-2 Il. 13.759, 771.

u(pokri/nomai.head: ὑποκρίνομαι
u(pokri/nomai.html: ὑποκρίνομαι [ὑπο- 12.] 3 sing. aor. opt. ὑποκρίναιτο Il. 12.228 : Od. 15.170. Imp. ὑπόκριναι Od. 19.535. Infin. ὑποκρίνασθαι Od. 19.555. 1 To give an interpretative response in regard to, to interpret, expound (cf. κρίνω 8): ὄνειρον Od. 19.535, 555. Absol.: ὧδέ χʼ ὑποκρίναιτο θεοπρόπος Il. 12.228. Cf. Od. 15.170 (read the sign). 2 To respond by a declaration of one's will or purpose: μῦθον ἀκούεις, ὥς τοι ὑποκρίνονται Il. 7.407. Cf. Od. 2.111.

u(perh/nwr.head: Ὑπερήνωρ
u(perh/nwr.html: Ὑπερήνωρ (ἱππόδαμος, ποιμὴν λαῶν ). Son of Panthous. Killed by Menelaus Il. 14.516, Il. 17.24.

u(yi/pulos.head: ὑψίπυλος
u(yi/pulos.html: ὑψίπυλος -ον [ὕψι + πύλη.] With lofty gates : Θήβην Il. 6.416, Τροίην Il. 16.698= Il. 21.544.

u(me/naios.head: ὑμέναιος
u(me/naios.html: ὑμέναιος ὁ. A wedding or bridal song : πολὺς ὑμέναιος ὀρώρει Il. 18.493.

u(pekfe/rw.head: ὑπεκφέρω
u(pekfe/rw.html: ὑπεκφέρω [ὑπ-, ὑπο- 3, ὑπο- 4 + ἐκ- 1.] 1 To remove from the range or area of. With genit. : υἱὸν πολέμοιο Il. 5.318, 377. 2 To move (a shield) outwards by elevating the base Il. 8.268. 3 Intrans. for reflexive, of horses, to carry themselves forward, speed onwards (cf. ἐκφέρω 6) Od. 3.496.

u(lh/eis.head: ὑλήεις
u(lh/eis.html: ὑλήεις -εντος. Fem. -εσσα [ὕλη.] Covered with woods, woody, (well) wooded : ὑπὸ πλάκῳ ὑληέσσῃ Il. 6.396, 425, Il. 22.479. Cf. Il. 10.362, Il. 13.12, Il. 17.748, Il. 21.449 : Od. 1.186, 246 = Od. 16.123 = Od. 19.131, Od. 9.24, 118, 191, Od. 10.308, Od. 14.2.

u(fi/hmi.head: †ὑφίημι
u(fi/hmi.html: †ὑφίημι [ὑφ-, ὑπο- 4 + ἵημι1.] Nom. pl. masc. aor. pple. ὑφέντες. To lower : ἱστόν Il. 1.434.

u(yipe/ths.head: ὑψιπέτης
u(yipe/ths.html: ὑψιπέτης [ὕψι + πέτομαι.] High-flying, soaring. Epithet of the eagle : αἰετός Il. 12.201= 219, Il. 13.822 : Od. 20.243.

u(laki/dhs.head: Ὑλακίδης
u(laki/dhs.html: Ὑλακίδης (υ). Patronymic of Castor-2 Od. 14.204.

u(pekprolu/w.head: ὑπεκπρολύω
u(pekprolu/w.html: ὑπεκπρολύω [ὑπ-, ὑπο- 1 + ἐκ- 1 + προ- 1.] To loose from under and from something (and send) forth. With genit.: ἡμιόνους ὑπεκπροέλυσαν ἀπήνης (loosed them from under the yoke, detached them from the waggon, and turned them off to graze) Od. 6.88.

u(peri/hmi.head: †ὑπερίημι
u(peri/hmi.html: †ὑπερίημι [ὑπερ- 3 + ἵημι1.] 3 sing. fut. ὑπερήσει. To throw beyond. With acc.: τόδε [σῆμα] Od. 8.198.

u(fa/w.head: †ὑφάω
u(fa/w.html: †ὑφάω 3 pl. pres. ὑφόωσι. To weave Od. 7.105.

u(perioni/dhs.head: Ὑπεριονίδης
u(perioni/dhs.html:
Ὑπεριονίδης [app. a double patronymic in form. See Ὑπερίων.] = Ὑπερίων. Ἠελίου Ὑπεριονίδαο Od. 12.176.
Ὑπεριονίδης Ὑπερίων. See Lexicon.

u(drhlo/s.head: ὑδρηλός
u(drhlo/s.html: ὑδρηλός [ὕδωρ.] Well watered Od. 9.133.

u(pakou/w.head: ὑπακούω
u(pakou/w.html: ὑπακούω [ὑπ-, ὑπο- 12.] 3 sing. aor. ὑπάκουσε Od. 14.485. Infin. ὑπακοῦσαι Od. 4.283. 1 To listen, give ear Od. 14.485. 2 To listen and make response, to answer, reply : ἔνδοθεν ὑπακοῦσαι Od. 4.283. Cf. Od. 10.83.

u(po/rnumi.head: †ὑπόρνυμι
u(po/rnumi.html: †ὑπόρνυμι [ὑπ-, ὑπο- 11.] 3 sing. redup. aor. ὑπώρορε. To stir the heart of: τοῖον ὑπώρορε [Ἀργείους] μοῦσα Od. 24.62.

u(datotrefh/s.head: ὑδατοτρεφής
u(datotrefh/s.html: ὑδατοτρεφής [ὑδατ-, ὕδωρ + τρέφω.] Nourished by water, loving water : αἰγείρων Od. 17.208.

u(postaxu/omai.head: ὑποσταχύομαι
u(postaxu/omai.html: ὑποσταχύομαι [ὑπο- 6 + στάχυς.] To yield increase: οὐδέ κεν ἄλλως ὑποσταχύοιτο βοῶν γένος Od. 20.212.

u(drai/nw.head: †ὑδραίνω
u(drai/nw.html: †ὑδραίνω [ὕδωρ.] Nom. sing. fem. aor. pple. mid. ὑδρηναμένη. In mid., to apply water to one's person, wash oneself, bathe : ὑδρηναμένη εὔχεʼ Ἀθηναίῃ (εὔχεο πᾶσι θεοῖσιν) Od. 4.750 = Od. 17.48. Cf. Od. 4.759 = Od. 17.58.

u(/par.head: ὕπαρ
u(/par.html: ὕπαρ τό. A waking reality, the actual sight of something : οὐκ ὄναρ, ἀλλʼ ὕπαρ Od. 19.547. Cf. Od. 20.90.

u(poxei/rios.head: ὑποχείριος
u(poxei/rios.html: ὑποχείριος [ὑπο- 4 + χείρ.] Under one's hand : χρυσόν, ὅτις χʼ ὑποχείριος ἔλθῃ (as much as I can lay my hands upon) Od. 15.448.

u(pofai/nw.head: †ὑποφαίνω
u(pofai/nw.html: †ὑποφαίνω [ὑπο- 1.] 3 sing. aor. ὑπέφηνε. To move from under so as to bring to the light, cause to peep from under. With genit. : θρῆνυν ὑπέφηνε τραπέζης Od. 17.409.

u(pozeu/gnumi.head: †ὑποζεύγνυμι
u(pozeu/gnumi.html: †ὑποζεύγνυμι [ὑπο- 4.] Aor. subj. ὑποζεύξω. To yoke (horses) : ἵππους Od. 15.81.

u(peca/gw.head: †ὑπεξάγω
u(peca/gw.html: †ὑπεξάγω [ὑπ-, ὑπο- 3 + ἐξ- 1.] 3 sing. aor. opt. ὑπεξαγάγοι. To remove out of danger, take in safety away Od. 18.147.

u(po/kuklos.head: ὑπόκυκλος
u(po/kuklos.html: ὑπόκυκλος [ὑπο- 4 + κύκλος.] Fitted with wheels or castors beneath : τάλαρον Od. 4.131.

u(podrhsth/r.head: ὑποδρηστήρ
u(podrhsth/r.html: ὑποδρηστήρ -ῆρος, ὁ [ὑπο- 5 + δρηστήρ. A servant under a master.] A servant or attendant Od. 15.330.

u(poperka/zw.head: ὑποπερκάζω
u(poperka/zw.html: ὑποπερκάζω [ὑπο- 12 + περκάζω in sim. sense, fr. περκ- as in περκνός.] To assume a dark hue, colour (the prefix app. indicating that this takes place under some influence, i.e. that of the sun): ἕτεραι [σταφυλαὶ] ὑποπερκάζουσιν Od. 7.126.

u(perqu/rion.head: ὑπερθύριον
u(perqu/rion.html: ὑπερθύριον τό [ὑπερ- 1 + θύρη.] The lintel of a door Od. 7.90.

u(yi/kerws.head: ὑψίκερως
u(yi/kerws.html: ὑψίκερως [ὕψι + κέρας.] High-horned : ὑψίκερων ἔλαφον Od. 10.158.

u(podmw/s.head: ὑποδμώς
u(podmw/s.html: ὑποδμώς ὁ [ὑπο- 5 + δμώς. A servant under a master.] A servant or minister Od. 4.386.

u(pa/rxw.head: †ὑπάρχω
u(pa/rxw.html: †ὑπάρχω [ὑπ-, ὑπο- 12.] 3 sing. aor. subj. ὑπάρξῃ. To make a beginning, give a lead, set an example : ἡ γὰρ θέμις, ὅς τις ὑπάρξῃ (for that is due to him who has first hospitably entreated another) Od. 24.286.

u(poklope/omai.head: ὑποκλοπέομαι
u(poklope/omai.html: ὑποκλοπέομαι [ὑπόκλοπος fr. ὑποκλέπτω fr. ὑπο- 4 + κλέπτω.] To conceal oneself in some hiding-place, keep out of sight: εἴ τις ζωὸς ὑποκλοπέοιτο Od. 22.382.

u(dreu/w.head: ὑδρεύω
u(dreu/w.html: ὑδρεύω [ὕδωρ.] To draw water Od. 10.105. In mid.: ὅθεν ὑδρεύοντο πολῖται Od. 7.131, Od. 17.206.

u(/mnos.head: ὕμνος
u(/mnos.html: ὕμνος -ου, ὁ. A lay : ὕμνον ἀκούων Od. 8.429.

u(aki/nqinos.head: ὑακίνθινος
u(aki/nqinos.html: ὑακίνθινος [ὑάκινθος.] Of the ὑάκινθος : κόμας ὑακινθίνῳ ἄνθει ὁμοίας Od. 6.231 = Od. 23.158 (the point of resemblance app. being in the clustering flowers with their curling petals).

u(lako/mwros.head: ὑλακόμωρος
u(lako/mwros.html: ὑλακόμωρος [ὑλακ- as in ὑλαγμός. Cf. ἐγχεσίμωρος, ἰόμωρος.] App., delighting in barking or baying. Epithet of dogs Od. 14.29, Od. 16.4.

u(ponh/ios.head: Ὑπονήϊος
u(ponh/ios.html:
Ὑπονήϊος -ον [ὑπο- 4 + νήϊον.] Lying under Mount Neïum: Ἰθάκης Od. 3.81.
Ὑπονήϊος Lying under Mount Neium (Neritum). Of Ithaca Od. 3.81 .

u(pekprore/w.head: ὑπεκπρορέω
u(pekprore/w.html: ὑπεκπρορέω [ὑπ-, ὑπο- 1 + ἐκ- 1 + προ- 1.] To flow from beneath something on and out : ὕδωρ ὑπεκπρορέει (wells up from the communication of the troughs with the river, passes on, and flows out of the troughs) Od. 6.87.

u(postore/nnumi.head: †ὑποστορέννυμι
u(postore/nnumi.html: †ὑποστορέννυμι [ὑπο- 4.] Aor. infin. ὑποστορέσαι. To spread (a bed) for the reception of a sleeper Od. 20.139.

u(fanto/s.head: ὑφαντός
u(fanto/s.html: ὑφαντός -ή, -όν [ὑφαίνω.] Woven : ἐσθῆτα Od. 13.136= Od. 16.231, εἵματα Od. 13.218.

u(perwio/qen.head: ὑπερωϊόθεν
u(perwio/qen.html: ὑπερωϊόθεν [ὑπερώϊον + -θεν 1.] From the women's quarters: ὑ. σύνθετʼ ἀοιδήν Od. 1.328.

u(pomna/omai.head: †ὑπομνάομαι
u(pomna/omai.html: †ὑπομνάομαι [ὑπο- 12.] 2 pl. impf. ὑπεμνάασθε. To woo or court (the wife of a living husband) (the prefix implying that the wooers seek a right concurrent, and therefore in conflict, with the husband's rights) : αὐτοῦ ζώοντος ὑπεμνάασθε γυναῖκα Od. 22.38.

u(yago/rhs.head: ὑψαγόρης
u(yago/rhs.html: ὑψαγόρης [ὕψι + ἀγορή.] Voc. ὑψαγόρη Od. 2.85, 303, Od. 17.406. One who talks loudly and boldly : Τηλέμαχʼ ὑψαγόρη Od. 2.85= Od. 17.406, Od. 2.303. Cf. Od. 1.385.

u(pomimnh/skw.head: †ὑπομιμνήσκω
u(pomimnh/skw.html: †ὑπομιμνήσκω [ὑπο- 11.] Fut. pple. fem. ὑπομνήσουσα Od. 15.3. 3 sing. aor. ὑπέμνησε Od. 1.321. To remind (a person) of (something), cause (him) to think or bethink himself of (it). With genit.: ὑπέμνησέ ἑ πατρός Od. 1.321. Cf. Od. 15.3.

u(periktai/nomai.head: ὑπερικταίνομαι
u(periktai/nomai.html: ὑπερικταίνομαι [app. ὑπ-, ὑπο- 4 + an unknown ἐρικταίνομαι.] Of the feet, perh., to hobble along beneath one : πόδες ὑπερικταίνοντο Od. 23.3.

u(peropli/zomai.head: †ὑπεροπλίζομαι
u(peropli/zomai.html: †ὑπεροπλίζομαι [ὑπέροπλος.] 3 sing. aor. opt. ὑπεροπλίσσαιτο. To scorn, despise, look down upon Od. 17.268.
